summary: SplitSync Iteration 8 (Biometric Lock) validated end-to-end within the scope testable on web preview. Backend regression: 119/119 pytest cases pass in serial (`pytest -n 0`, 128.6s) covering /api/auth/me, /api/expenses (validation + receipt round-trip), /api/friends, /api/groups, /api/settlements, /api/recurring (validation + monthly USD), /api/scan (413 size cap + 429 per-user hourly rate limit + generic 502 surface), /api/insights, /api/trends (6 months), /api/fx (USD/INR/EUR/GBP/JPY), CORS credential-less preflight. Frontend: login screen renders correctly in both LIGHT and DARK (color_scheme=dark emulation); LockProvider mounts without crashing; testID='lock-screen' is NEVER rendered pre-auth on web (Platform.OS==='web' short-circuits both initial-lock and background→foreground auto-lock in LockContext.tsx L28,43,57,71); Profile screen exposes testID='biometric-lock-toggle' with disabled visual state when !lock.available (which is always true on web since `available = supported && enrolled && Platform.OS !== 'web'`). Auth-gated redirects still work: `/`, `/(tabs)/dashboard`, `/insights` all → `/login` when unauthenticated. Zero PAGEERRORs. Only console messages: the pre-existing 'shadow* deprecated' RN-Web warning (unrelated to iter8) and two expected 401 'unauthorized' logs from the pre-auth `/api/auth/me` probe. app.json correctly declares NSFaceIDUsageDescription in ios.infoPlist, Android permissions USE_BIOMETRIC + USE_FINGERPRINT, and expo-local-authentication plugin with faceIDPermission string. Real biometric unlock cannot be simulated on web preview — per review-request note, that is out of scope and requires a physical device.
critical_code_review_comments: LockContext.tsx correctly gates all biometric paths on Platform.OS !== 'web': (a) initial lock decision (L43), (b) AppState background→foreground auto-lock (L57), (c) unlock short-circuits to setLocked(false) on web (L71), (d) setEnabled skips the enable-prompt on web (L91). Web bypass is watertight.

LockProvider is nested inside AuthProvider via LockGate() in _layout.tsx so useAuth() is safe; user prop drives the isLoggedIn signal correctly. Ordering: GestureHandler > SafeArea > Theme > Auth > Fx > Lock > AuthGate — good.

LockContext.tsx L50 useEffect deps are intentionally empty with an eslint-disable comment; the comment explains the intent (avoid re-locking on session refresh). Acceptable, but a stale-closure risk if isLoggedIn transitions from false→true post-mount and user expects auto-lock — non-blocking for iter8 since the AppState listener covers the runtime path.

profile.tsx correctly short-circuits the toggle when !lock.available (L96) and shows the appropriate subtitle text ('Not supported on this device' vs 'No biometrics enrolled') — good UX on web where available is forced false.

app.json plugin block includes ['expo-local-authentication', {faceIDPermission: ...}] which will drive prebuild to also inject Android USE_BIOMETRIC/USE_FINGERPRINT and iOS NSFaceIDUsageDescription automatically; the manual entries in ios.infoPlist + android.permissions are consistent belt-and-suspenders — no conflict.
server.py still 921 lines — split-into-routers carry-over from iter6/7 remains outstanding.
_SCAN_HITS rate-limit bucket remains per-process memory only (carry-over from iter6/7); would require Redis/Mongo TTL for horizontal scale.
Currency validation still duplicated across /expenses, /recurring, /auth/currency (carry-over from iter6/7).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the scope testable without Google OAuth: login renders in both themes with LockProvider mounted, lock-screen NEVER rendered on web pre-auth, all auth-gated redirects work, 0 PAGEERRORs, no 'Cannot read properties of undefined' crashes, biometric-lock-toggle testID present in Profile (verified via code inspection)

seed_data_creation: Reused existing seed user_test_fixture01 / test_token_abc (conftest.py) and module-scoped rl_user (TEST_scan_rl_user_iter6) from test_iteration6.py. No new seed data added for iter8 (backend unchanged since iter6).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter8 adds biometric lock (frontend-only; backend unchanged since iter6). Full backend regression: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -n 0 -v` (~2m10s). If rate-limit test fails at call 1, restart backend to reset in-memory _SCAN_HITS bucket. Web-preview biometric wiring verified: (a) LockProvider gates on Platform.OS==='web' at every mutation point in LockContext.tsx (L28/43/57/71/91), (b) testID='lock-screen' NEVER renders pre-auth on web, (c) Profile has testID='biometric-lock-toggle' at profile.tsx L101 with disabled visual/behavior when !lock.available. Actual Face ID / fingerprint verification is NOT testable on web preview — requires a physical iOS/Android device. app.json declares NSFaceIDUsageDescription, USE_BIOMETRIC, USE_FINGERPRINT, and the expo-local-authentication plugin correctly. Login screen testIDs: 'login-screen', 'login-logo', 'google-signin-button'.
